title: Tic Tac pilots' names told to Bishop before release as a test

tellings.quote: I know you're telling me this cuz you see I'm going to leak stuff about the tic tac incident and pilots whose names hadn't been released yet. I was told don't talk about this.

plain: The UFO writer Greg Bishop says that someone once told him the names of Navy pilots from the Tic Tac incident before those names were public. The Tic Tac incident was a 2004 encounter in which Navy fighter pilots, among them David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, reported a white oval object shaped like the mint. Bishop tells Michels he took this as a test of whether he would leak, since he had been told not to talk about it, which would mean someone was watching what he did with secrets.
